definitions.full: H889. beosh בְּאשׁ noun masculine stench — ׳בּ construct Amos 4:10 ; suffix בָּאְשׁוֺ Joel 2:20 ; בָּאְשָׁם Isa 34:3 ; — ׳בּ מַחֲנֵיכֶם , i.e. stench of corpses Amos 4:10 , also Isa 34:3 ; compare Joel 2:20 of locusts בּ ׳עָלָה || צַחֲנָתוֺׅ (תַּעַל .
